L: Level of the echo relative to the pulse sent
Z_1: Acoustic impedance of the first medium
Z_2: Acoustic impedance of the second medium
a: Attenuation coefficient of the amplitude, in nepers
d: Depth of the boundary below the transducer
e: Euler's number, the base of natural logarithms
p_0: Pressure amplitude where the wave starts
r: Share of the pressure a boundary reflects
t: Time of the echo after the pulse is sent
z: Depth the scanner assumes for an echo
